payload.summary_zh: GEO PRO 基于 GEOFlow 2.3.0 的品牌化 fork：深度去上游标识、移除线索表单、新增真后端网站 GEO 体检钩子，并配套 JetSocio 四产品引流 Hub。
payload.summary_en: GEO PRO is a rebranded fork of GEOFlow 2.3.0: upstream branding stripped, lead forms removed, a real-backend website GEO audit added, and integrated with the JetSocio four-product hub.
payload.upgrade_tip_zh: 升级前请先完成数据库迁移，运行 geoflow:security-audit 安全审计，确认队列 queue 与 readiness 就绪；本 fork 默认关闭上游遥测与更新检查，并删除不必要的上游外联。
payload.upgrade_tip_en: Before upgrading, run database migrations via migrate and geoflow:security-audit, and verify queue workers and readiness; this fork disables upstream telemetry and update checks by default.
